topics.name: Multimodal representation alignment and adaptation
topics.summary: These papers compare shared representations, parameter injection, and modality-specific routing across language and vision. Their results show uneven transfer between modalities, favoring selective adaptation and reliability-aware fusion over uniform integration.

topics.name: Graph representation and structure learning
topics.summary: The studies examine how topology, positional encodings, rewiring, and pooling affect graph representations. Experiments and theory connect long-range information flow, relational semantics, and adaptive community structure to downstream prediction quality.

topics.name: LLM behavior, alignment, and latent control
topics.summary: These works measure behavioral drift, social preferences, and internal features in language models using statistical tests, sparse probes, and activation interventions. Together they show that optimization and prompting can expose stable biases while targeted representation changes can alter selected behaviors.

topics.name: Agent memory and personalization
topics.summary: These systems maintain editable histories, temporal graphs, user profiles, and reusable records for cross-session language agents. Evaluations emphasize retrieval, correction, abstraction, and serving efficiency, while showing that durable preferences and procedures require more than simple fact storage.

topics.name: Sequential recommendation and personalized ranking
topics.summary: The recommender studies use temporal attention, semantic item representations, privileged training signals, contextual bandits, and instance-specific fusion. Across cold-start and industrial settings, they target better ranking, diversity, latency, and adaptation to changing feedback or item lifecycles.

topics.name: Scientific and domain-grounded AI agents
topics.summary: These agents combine language models with structured domain knowledge, planners, executable solvers, and operational feedback. Applications span scientific programming, hardware kernels, power systems, and urban data, with explicit constraints improving reliability on costly real-world tasks.

topics.name: LLM agent skill evolution and test-time learning
topics.summary: The papers improve agents through rollout-based optimization, experience curation, mentor feedback, and controlled skill acceptance. Results indicate that preserving diverse reasoning paths and diagnosing recurring execution failures supports more stable transfer than unconstrained self-modification.

topics.name: Adaptive and robust robot control
topics.summary: These control methods combine learned dynamics with adaptive, sliding-mode, backstepping, and risk-aware feedback for nonlinear robots and vehicles. Analyses and experiments address disturbances, delays, flexible mechanisms, unknown motion, and collision constraints while maintaining bounded tracking error.

topics.name: Speech and audio generation and processing
topics.summary: These studies address moving-source tracking, distributed beamforming, phoneme-aware singing synthesis, voice style transfer, and temporally structured audio generation. Their systems use spatial adaptation, explicit linguistic or melodic conditioning, and multidimensional evaluation to improve robustness and fidelity.

topics.name: Calibration-light human sensing and handwriting reconstruction
topics.summary: The methods infer human activity or pen motion from Wi-Fi, ultrasound, inertial, and hover-contact signals with limited per-user calibration. Cross-rate alignment, zero-shot semantic transfer, temporal models, and writer adaptation improve reconstruction under hardware and demographic variation.

topics.name: Robust sensor fusion under degraded measurements
topics.summary: These systems combine physical residual models, environmental context, and physiological checks to resolve incomplete or conflicting sensor observations. Applications include ship motion, low-SNR wireless channels, and pulse estimation, with reliability improving when domain structure guides fusion.

topics.name: Molecular and materials discovery
topics.summary: The papers apply language-model representations, graph screening, domain adaptation, and fast flow-based generation to molecules, enzymes, biosynthetic systems, and photocatalysts. Their pipelines use learned structural signals to prioritize candidates before expensive experimental or computational validation.

topics.name: Social, affective, and collaborative human-AI interaction
topics.summary: These studies model hidden motives, emotion context, partner beliefs, and creative group dynamics in multimodal and conversational settings. Findings favor interaction histories, explicit mental-state modeling, and preserved human rejection or reflection to maintain social responsiveness and diversity.

topics.name: Medical imaging, reconstruction, and shift robustness
topics.summary: These papers use segmentation, bilateral anatomy, radiomics, token selection, sparse autoencoders, CT, ECG, and MRI reconstruction to improve clinical vision. Results repeatedly stress localized evidence, efficient representations, external-cohort testing, and the difficulty of maintaining calibration across sites and devices.

topics.name: Clinical vision-language modeling and safety
topics.summary: These studies ground diagnosis and report generation in anatomy, terminology, and expert-localized evidence while testing behavior under missing or misleading clinical information. They show that semantic alignment needs abstention, intervention checks, and clinician oversight to limit confident diagnostic errors.

topics.name: Diffusion, flow, and efficient image generation
topics.summary: These methods shape continuous generative dynamics, latent initialization, attention features, and student-teacher distributions to reduce sampling cost or improve controllability. Experiments target image synthesis, editing, and one-step generation while preserving composition, diversity, and prompt fidelity.

topics.name: Long-horizon and interactive video generation
topics.summary: The video systems use chunked streaming, bounded memory, trajectory conditioning, spectral or latent regularization, and entity-centered retrieval. These mechanisms support long clips, changing prompts, roaming views, physical events, and identity continuity while reducing temporal drift.

topics.name: 3D scene, point-cloud, and geospatial reconstruction
topics.summary: These papers use Gaussian primitives, point-cloud synthesis, multi-date satellite matching, depth priors, scene graphs, and geometric constraints for 3D understanding. Evaluations emphasize compact representations, cross-view consistency, seasonal robustness, open-vocabulary localization, and controllable camera behavior.

topics.name: Robust visual recognition and synthetic data
topics.summary: The studies improve deployment under visual domain shift using geometric cues, expert distillation, transition-aware scoring, and controlled mixtures of real and procedurally generated images. Results show that spatial structure and carefully balanced synthetic data can improve recognition without eliminating mismatch risk.

topics.name: Biometric anti-spoofing and foundation vision
topics.summary: Audio and face authenticity systems combine pretrained encoders with reconstruction, regional evidence, and task-specific decoders. Across changing capture conditions and limited-label eye or face datasets, selective adaptation matters more than relying on a frozen foundation representation alone.

topics.name: Code generation, program synthesis, and code intelligence
topics.summary: These papers improve software agents through syntax-aware rewards, insertion-based generation, execution feedback, repository-scale retrieval, graph-verified vulnerability analysis, and reusable feature synthesis. Their evaluations show that executable behavior, structural quality, and repeated implementation consistency complement ordinary code-match scores.

topics.name: Uncertainty, calibration, and shift-robust prediction
topics.summary: These methods use conformal procedures, adaptive updates, quantile reconciliation, interval transfer, and uncertainty-ranked sensing to make predictions reliable under changing distributions. The results emphasize coverage and calibration diagnostics rather than relying on average accuracy alone.

topics.name: Robust optimization under heavy-tailed noise
topics.summary: The analyses study stochastic optimization and estimation when gradients or observations contain extreme values. Finite-moment convergence results and robust block aggregation describe how to retain clean-data efficiency while limiting the influence of atypical samples.

topics.name: Retrieval, RAG, and knowledge-intensive search
topics.summary: These systems combine dense and lexical retrieval, hierarchical graph exploration, phrase interactions, compact indexes, teacher-student transfer, and reranking. Applications span conversational memory, scientific and financial documents, recommendation, tables, and multilingual search, with context selection improving grounding and recall.

topics.name: Structured information extraction and multimodal knowledge
topics.summary: The papers turn text, images, and scientific figures into explicit entities, relations, and domain structures using constrained decoding, candidate restriction, calibrated priors, and multimodal parsing. Structured outputs improve consistency when evidence is sparse, noisy, or hierarchically organized.

topics.name: Multimodal reasoning, grounding, and explainability
topics.summary: These evaluations use counterfactual interventions, token provenance, depth and relation predicates, and controlled visual inputs to test whether models rely on evidence rather than shortcuts. Findings show that high answer accuracy can coexist with weak grounding or fragile support after compression.

topics.name: Multimodal and generative model safety
topics.summary: The studies evaluate jailbreaks, encoded prompts, speech-based attacks, adversarial image edits, and culturally specific or temporal safety cases. Defense comparisons show that filtering, decoding changes, recovery checks, and expert benchmarks each cover different failure modes and incur utility costs.

topics.name: Agent security, authorization, and governance
topics.summary: These papers treat deployed agents as systems that need runtime permissions, telemetry, provenance, deception resistance, and memory integrity. Tests in browser, open-source, and security settings reveal that policy reminders alone do not replace explicit authorization, intervention, and escalation mechanisms.

topics.name: Long-horizon agent evaluation and trace reliability
topics.summary: These benchmarks assess extended agent workflows with persistent state, tool calls, realistic constraints, executable deliverables, voice behavior, and trajectory validity. They show that final answers can hide failures in planning, disclosure, database state, or behavioral compliance.

topics.name: Tool use, planning, and inference budgets
topics.summary: The systems allocate tool calls and reasoning effort using expected value, early stopping, action graphs, formal task constraints, and lightweight refinement. Results favor selective search and structured planning when costs are high, while showing that reliability estimates determine when deferral is worthwhile.

topics.name: LLM reasoning evaluation and benchmark validity
topics.summary: Controlled tasks and psychometric analyses test whether deliberation improves evidence use, confidence, and logical competence. The findings show that longer reasoning and aggregate benchmark scores can obscure calibration failures, surface-form bias, and differences between separable skills.

topics.name: Efficient and reliable model inference
topics.summary: These studies reduce deployment cost through quantization, sparse replacements, serverless decomposition, energy accounting, adaptive rounding, and speculative decoding. Diagnostics show that memory traffic, draft-target agreement, confidence behavior, and error patterns matter alongside throughput or task accuracy.

topics.name: Data selection for small tabular learning
topics.summary: The experiments compare random, diversity-based, feature-coverage, and distribution-aware selection strategies for small tabular datasets. They find that partition quality and representative context can dominate downstream results, making data composition a central evaluation variable.

topics.name: Bayesian optimization for noisy model search
topics.summary: These studies use surrogate models that represent uncertainty to search expensive trading and reinforcement-learning configuration spaces. Exploration is balanced against outcome variability, so selection favors solutions that are both promising and dependable under repeated evaluation.

topics.name: Spiking neural networks for temporal perception
topics.summary: The papers analyze recurrent memory, event timing, and sequence-aware training in spiking vision models. Results indicate that energy savings depend on temporal workload and state retention, while event-based supervision helps preserve information across detection intervals.

topics.name: LLM-assisted scientific literature organization
topics.summary: These systems apply retrieval, eligibility screening, topic assignment, and explainable text classification to scientific corpora. Survey and biomedical indexing results show that language models can accelerate organization when their labels and evidence remain inspectable.

topics.name: Causal inference and temporal graph reasoning
topics.summary: The methods combine subgroup modeling, interventions, abduction, graph editing, and time-aware attention to study heterogeneous effects and changing relational structure. Evaluations distinguish predictive association from intervention value, root causes, and decisions that remain valid as state evolves.

topics.name: Federated learning under heterogeneity and attacks
topics.summary: These papers design client grouping and collaboration around relational structure rather than identical model coordinates. Entropy-guided clusters, coalition allocation, topology sharing, and suspicious-update detection improve communication efficiency and resilience to heterogeneous backbones or malicious clients.

topics.name: Ensemble learning and generalization
topics.summary: The studies connect ensemble diversity, margin behavior, stability, feature perturbations, and architecture selection to generalization. Theory and experiments suggest that complementary members can matter as much as individual accuracy when building robust predictors.

topics.name: EEG representation learning and signal reconstruction
topics.summary: These methods learn subject-level EEG features from unlabeled segments and reconstruct missing channels or time regions with generative models. Multiple-instance aggregation and flexible temporal modeling reduce dependence on dense clinical labels while preserving signal structure.

topics.name: Indoor visual localization and operational navigation
topics.summary: The systems combine multi-hypothesis localization, floorplan geometry, clearance constraints, and instrument-specific approach regions for indoor tasks. Their emphasis is on reaching a usable pose in repetitive environments rather than merely identifying an object or map coordinate.

topics.name: Robot manipulation learning and transfer
topics.summary: These methods use 3-D kinematics, spoken or visual commands, autonomous practice, symmetry-aware replay, latent action models, translated demonstrations, and failure-aware steering. Across simulated and physical robots, they improve data efficiency, embodiment transfer, and long-horizon manipulation reliability.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and neural surrogates
topics.summary: These studies build reduced-order, graph-based, Gaussian-process, and neural surrogate models for physical dynamics and scientific regression. They evaluate accuracy, stability, extrapolation, differentiability, and storage or inference cost when observations and simulations are limited.

topics.name: Human-computer interaction for visual workflows
topics.summary: These empirical studies examine spatial mixed reality for drone operations and the labor involved in building visualization stimuli. Findings emphasize situational awareness, scalable coordination, and the hidden workflow costs behind apparently simple visual interfaces.

topics.name: AI-assisted compliance documentation
topics.summary: The systems extract product and technical attributes into structured compliance records using plugin-based collection, language-model parsing, and validation. Their workflows improve coverage of weakly stated information and make documentation more reusable across artifacts and standards.

topics.name: Diffusion-image watermarking
topics.summary: These methods pair approximate diffusion inversion with spatially synchronized message designs to preserve watermark recovery after geometric edits. Evaluations balance verification speed, reconstruction quality, and robustness to cropping, rotation, scaling, and unseen distortions.

topics.name: Context-aware scientific figure assessment
topics.summary: The studies evaluate figures together with captions, citations, and manuscript claims using expert-labeled data and multimodal scoring. Context-aware judgments improve agreement and reduce dependence on generic visual quality measures or unconstrained model impressions.

topics.name: Machine learning for Earth observation
topics.summary: These papers use multispectral classification, diffusion-based synthesis, wavelet features, and map-conditioned generation for satellite imagery. Applications include volcanic-cloud monitoring and filling gaps where independently maintained geographic sources cannot provide aligned observations.

topics.name: AI for hardware design and deployment
topics.summary: The systems place quantized hardware measurements, executable geometry, rendering, and simulation inside model or layout search loops. Their evaluations show that fabrication and deployment constraints must influence generation rather than being checked only after design selection.

topics.name: Embodied AI infrastructure and experimentation
topics.summary: These contributions expose intermediate states, interventions, telemetry, and provenance for agents operating in simulated worlds or laboratory hardware. Deterministic execution and structured records support repeatable training, evaluation, and physical experimentation.

topics.name: Predictive world models for embodied interaction
topics.summary: The papers learn action-conditioned futures for games and robots, preserving distinctions between candidate outcomes and checking executions against predicted observations. Their models support longer-horizon control by representing consequences rather than generating visually plausible frames alone.

topics.name: Structured planning and state abstraction
topics.summary: These methods reduce long-horizon decision complexity through visual-symbolic goals, causal state grouping, temporal logic, and recursively trackable memory states. The resulting abstractions support near-optimal policies without retaining every geometric or factored state detail.

topics.name: Blockchain transaction behavior and Sybil detection
topics.summary: The studies identify Ethereum Sybil behavior from transaction timing, execution semantics, and compression-based similarity graphs. Leakage controls, temporal validation, and training-free candidate expansion address camouflage and changing wallet behavior more realistically than random splits.

topics.name: Foundation model training and domain adaptation
topics.summary: These works modify data synthesis, preference supervision, batching, candidate exploration, and filtering to adapt language models under limited budgets. Results show that targeted training signals can improve specialized performance, but gains depend on capacity, selection quality, and transfer demands.

topics.name: Interpretable machine-learning representations
topics.summary: The papers make representations inspectable through local linear explanations, distortion analysis, and representative prototype selection. Their evaluations span tabular, text, image, and temporal data, showing how compact evidence can clarify nonlinear models without explaining every feature.

topics.name: Simulation and monitoring for surgical robotics
topics.summary: These systems support autonomous suturing with GPU-parallel contact simulation and action-conditioned deviation monitoring. The combination enables reinforcement-learning data generation and calibrated failure alarms even when successful demonstrations are more available than labeled failures.

topics.name: Preference learning for agent alignment
topics.summary: The studies use vision-language evaluation and informed human teaching to shape evolving robot morphologies, motions, or learned policies. They show that feedback quality, teacher knowledge, and evaluator consistency strongly affect convergence and the resulting notion of alignment.
